prompts.boughs: Reconstruct one isolated movable sprite from this exact painting. The ONLY objects on this transparent sprite are the two large outer curling wood boughs flowing down into their purple fabric cuffs and then converging downward INTO the integral treant face, including BOTH wrapped golden cords and spiral dangling charms beside the face. It should look as if the original artist painted this same structural layer with all the other layers turned off. Maintain precise angular golden wood strokes, thick curling wood tips, small green moss ribbons, matched placement of all joins, original upper-left illumination, strong umber shadows, ocher and auburn grain. Both cuff hems are long and tattered, deep purple, the left has a faded ivory crescent print and right an ivory spreading tree print. Exactly the same tall furious carved treant face: narrow bright green eyes, furrowed angular honey-gold brows, long wedge nose, open dark mouth, pointed beard. Closely match the complete original geometry and silhouette coordinates: both tips originate near x0.28 and 0.74 y0.11, cuffs centered x0.26 and .75 y.44, face spans x.38-.62, y.56-.79. Preserve the original large completely hollow central window and proportions. EVERYTHING ELSE omitted, leaving genuine transparent space inside and outside: all loose leaves, central green leaf and short inside sprout fork, board, crown, feathers, side planks, and roots all belong to other layers. Paint complete hidden surfaces, isolated fully padded clean alpha. No shape or material redesign. No background hue or cast shadow outside the asset.
prompts.front: Edit image TWO (the isolated U-shaped ornament). Image ONE is style reference. Erase precisely two extraneous structures and repair the immediately adjacent underlaps: 1. Remove the upward-pointing TWO small wood horns immediately above the treant’s forehead INSIDE the U. The big outer wrapped boughs remain continuous and complete. 2. Remove the entire long twisted beard of roots BELOW and BEHIND the FACE. These two other appendages will be painted on separate movable layers. FACE, golden spiral charms, spirit tree and moon cloth prints, moss and the large outer curled boughs stay identical. Keep both eyes, open mouth, rough faceted chin, warm original highlights and tattered purple hems. True transparent outside and inside the window. Do not add hanging roots or beard below the golden chin.
prompts.foundation: Isolate and reconstruct ONLY the central shield backboard from the reference, as if lifting off every other ornament. The crescent AND round moon boss are a separate layer: leave this small central crown patch plain brown carved wood. The deep-plum recessed leaf panel below should have radiating broad plum planes, deepest violet below the gable edge and strong restrained painterly grain exactly as target. Front elevation, shield sides modestly narrow downward terminating behind the future treant. Broad crest-shaped board only, proportions width 0.97 times height. No central green leaf, treant, projecting side planks, straps, gems, branches, sprout fork, foliage or feather. Paint the WHOLE underlying board, hidden surfaces too. Isolated true transparency around outer silhouette, no ambient background.
